judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used for formatting, not a paper describing the 2020 BCI competition imagined speech dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
